deferred.claim: Cast without beholding a Dragon: counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}.
deferred.basis: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may behold a Dragon. (You may choose a Dragon you control or reveal a Dragon card from your hand.) ... Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}. If a Dragon was beheld, counter that spell unless its controller pays {4} instead.
